question: Why are 21 families PRODUCT_PATH_PENDING, and is any of it executable now?
theAnswerIsNotThatTheyAreStuck: PRODUCT_PATH_PENDING is not a hold nobody has looked at. Sixteen of the twenty-one carry an explicit executionReclassification -- an owner decision that moved the family OUT of the legal queue and into route-mapping work, with the reasoning recorded and an exact next executable action written down. az_record_sealing_arrest_no_charges-set's says it plainly: 'This is record-driven route mapping, not a general legal question.'
whatThatMeansForTheCount: They are assigned work, not open questions. Five are assigned to LEGAL-PURGE-W3 and FIVE ARE ASSIGNED TO THE CAPTAIN -- which is to say they are mine to dispatch and I had not been dispatching them. Eleven carry no execution owner at all and are the genuinely unassigned remainder.
aShapeToWatch: Two of them -- rcap-oh-custom-pleading-clean-tracks and wa_vac_substance_use_disorder-set -- carry a current independent verdict of BLOCKED_LEGAL_INPUT while sitting at PRODUCT_PATH_PENDING, because the reclassification override is read before the verdict. Their legalInputStatus reads SETTLED and the owner decision says the remaining question is mapping rather than law, so the override is deliberate. Recorded so that a later reader does not mistake it for the state machine losing a legal block.
